## About this website

This site is the programme for the *DH Lab*. It is built with [Quarto](https://quarto.org/),
kept in a public [Git repository](https://github.com/DHBern/dh-lab/) and published automatically
with GitHub Pages — which is also one of the publication routes you learn here. Use the **Edit
this page** link in the right-hand margin to see the source of any page, and to propose a
change.

Corrections, dead links and better tools are welcome as
[issues](https://github.com/DHBern/dh-lab/issues/new/choose) or pull requests. Contributions from
participants are credited.

### Course materials

Datasets, scans and anything that cannot be published openly are in the [ILIAS course
space](https://ilias.unibe.ch/ilias.php?baseClass=ilrepositorygui&cmdNode=yv:ng&cmdClass=ilObjCourseGUI&ref_id=3733960),
accessible to enrolled students.
